preconditions.description: Number of destinations is between 2 and 100,000.
Number of Time Corridors is between n-1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b and 0 <= e <= 10**9 for a, b, e in edges)
preconditions.description: Each Time Corridor has valid destination indices and energy requirement.
No pair of destinations is repeated.

postconditions.description: The result is a valid energy requirement.
The result is the maximum energy requirement for the first Corridor such that it may still be used in a minimum spanning tree.
